title: CourseAsCode Feedback Activity
description: Schema for FBK_*.yaml Feedback activity files

Type.description: Activity type identifier — must be FEEDBACK (case-insensitive)

Description.description: Short description shown on the course page

EmailNotification.description: Send email notification to teachers on submission (0/1)

PublishStats.description: Show an analysis page to students after submitting (0/1)

CompletionSubmit.description: Mark complete when the student submits the feedback

Template.description: Template id this item came from (0 = none)

Name.description: The question text (or label text for label items)

Label.description: Optional short label for the item

Type.description: Item type: multichoice | textfield | textarea | numeric | label | info | captcha

Presentation.description: Moodle presentation/encoding string controlling how the item renders

HasValue.description: Whether the item produces an answer value (0/1)

Position.description: 1-based ordering of the item within the feedback

DependItem.description: Id of an item this one depends on (0 = none)

DependValue.description: Value the dependent item must have for this item to show

Options.description: Moodle item option flags (e.g. 'h' to hide numbering)
